userVerbatim:
1. 앱전화: 음성 재생 중 다른 앱으로 갔다 돌아와도 자동 재생 되지 않습니다.
2. 화면 잠금: 재생 중 잠근 뒤 돌아오면 소리가 멈추고 입이 닫혀 있습니다.
3. 다시 재생: ‘답변 듣기’를 누르면 소리와 입이 정상적으로 움직입니다.

results.observation: No automatic playback after returning from another app.
Audio is stopped and the mouth is closed after locking and returning.
Tapping 답변 듣기 restores normal audio and mouth movement.

scopeLimits: User report, not a new agent browser run or independently captured iPhone session.
Does not establish every language/appearance combination or absence of replayed gestures.
Does not establish latency, thermal behavior, battery consumption or phoneme alignment accuracy.

nextCheck.conditions: Existing stored-sample device screen; unplugged, stable brightness, speaker output if convenient. No new AI/TTS generation.
nextCheck.workload: Keep motion enabled; approximately 5 minutes per appearance. Manually replay the stored Korean/Japanese samples a few times during the interval, not continuously or automatically.
record: Actual duration and iPhone model if known
Warmth compared with the start: none / slight / clearly hot
Stutter, unresponsive controls or audio/mouth delay
Optional start/end battery percentage and output device
nextCheck.stopCondition: Stop if the device becomes clearly hot or displays a temperature warning.
nextCheck.limit: A short subjective observation is not a long-duration thermal benchmark or proof of zero heat; battery percentage alone does not isolate this app's consumption.

remainingChecks: Bluetooth comparison only if relevant to intended use
